military.t: 🚢 CENTCOM: ZERO Ships Past Blockade in First 24 Hours — 6 Turned Around

CENTCOM added: 'US forces are supporting freedom of navigation for vessels transiting Hormuz to and from non-Iranian ports.' One Iran-sanctioned tanker Elpis (departed Bushehr Mar 30, anchored in Iranian waters, moved Apr 13 ~6AM) passed through but was almost stationary in Gulf of Oman — status unclear. Rich Starry (China-owned, US-sanctioned) also passed Apr 13. Both flagged but not confirmed interdicted. Al Jazeera: 'Real risk of escalation here.'

I've been saying they can't have nuclear weapons.' US also demanded Iran remove HEU from the country; Iran agreed only to 'monitored down-blending' process. IAEA estimates Iran has ~1,000 lbs (440kg+) of HEU — enough material for approximately 11 nuclear weapons. Vance: 'We must have the enriched material out of Iran. We must have their conclusive commitment not to develop a nuclear weapon.'

Front-end loaders atop debris blocking tunnel entrances. Ceasefire technically halts strikes but Iran rebuilding during pause — as US military planners anticipated.

assessment.body:
Day 47 opens with a genuine diplomatic breakthrough signal — and serious structural warnings.

THE DIPLOMATIC WINDOW
• Second round of US-Iran talks confirmed for this week — Islamabad or Geneva
• Trump: 'something could be happening over the next two days' in Islamabad
• UN Sec-Gen Guterres: 'highly probable' talks restart
• Pakistan: 'reached out to Iran, got positive response for second round'
• Delegations keeping Friday through Sunday open (senior Iranian source, Reuters)
• Vance, Witkoff and Kushner expected to lead US side again
• KEY: Iran's team in Islamabad lacked authorization — they've now gone back to Tehran
• If higher-level authorization comes: deal possible before Apr 21 ceasefire expiry

NUCLEAR GAP — THE CORE ISSUE
• Vance offered Iran a 20-year enrichment suspension at Islamabad
• Iran countered with 3-5 years — both rejected
• US also demanded removal of HEU from Iran; Iran agreed only to 'monitored down-blending'
• IAEA: Iran has ~1,000 lbs (440kg+) HEU = material for ~11 nuclear weapons
• Trump: 'I don't like the 20 years. I've been saying they can't have nuclear weapons.'
• Vance: 'We must have the enriched material out of Iran'
• Iran: nuclear program is a 'source of national pride' — giving it up frames as surrender

BLOCKADE — ZERO SHIPS IN DAY 1
• CENTCOM confirmed: zero ships made it past blockade in first 24 hours
• 6 merchant ships followed orders to turn around
• Iran-sanctioned Elpis (from Bushehr) and Rich Starry (China) did transit — status unclear
• Dual compliance impossible: ships need BOTH US and Iranian permission
• Iran reconstituting missile bases during ceasefire (CNN satellite imagery)
• Iran oil exports remain resilient: $4.97B past month (Kpler) — China absorbing most

INDIA MARKET OUTLOOK — TODAY'S OPEN
• BSE/NSE reopen after 2-day break (Good Friday + Ambedkar Jayanti)
• GIFT Nifty 24,205 at 8:09 AM IST (-0.02%) — near-flat open expected
• TradingView: 'bullish set-up if Sensex opens above 77,000, target 77,500'
• FII -₹1,983 Cr / DII +₹2,432 Cr on Apr 13 (Trendlyne)
• Brent ~$98 — below $100 is positive for India
• IF second-round talks confirmed at open: Sensex could rally 500-800 pts toward 77,500-78,000
• IF any negative Iran development overnight: Sensex could retest 76,500 support
• India: 85%+ Hormuz crude dependency, ~6-8 weeks fuel buffer
• Emkay: Nifty target 29,000 Mar 2027 (if permanent deal). Morgan Stanley: Sensex ₹95,000 Dec 2026

KEY DATE: APRIL 21 — CEASEFIRE EXPIRY (6 DAYS)
• If deal before Apr 21: Brent could collapse to $70-80, Sensex surge 5-10%
• If no deal by Apr 21: ceasefire lapses — Iran maximum combat alert + Trump 'locked and loaded'
• If ceasefire extended: markets stable, diplomatic track continues
• Iran reconstituting missiles + IAEA: 11 nukes' worth of HEU + blockade holding = pressure mounting

VERDICT: Most consequential 6 days of the war. Second-round talks signal is the strongest positive development since Islamabad. But the nuclear gap (US wants zero enrichment forever; Iran won't give it up) is structural — not solvable in one meeting. Most likely outcome: ceasefire extension + ongoing talks. Worst case: no extension, blockade firms, Iran retaliates. Watch for formal announcement of talks location and date — that is the single most important signal for Indian markets today.
